title: In-game open control room
hook: **WIP:** open the RPG **without leaving** the lawn-game window (button / F10). Esc closes; the board pauses while you are away. Not finished yet.

blindSpots.meaning: Not finished. Today the usual path is still launcher + browser — see [local control room](local-control-room).
A door from inside the lawn-game window into the control room — not a second install and not alt-tab as the designed end state.
The planned hotkey alongside an on-screen button. Treat missing F10 as unfinished, not a broken keymap forever.
Design: the board pauses while the control room is open from in-game. Esc closes it.
The local browser shell for Sanctum, Lawn, roster, and more — already playable via launcher + browser.

alsoTrue: You can already run the full local control room without this button.
Lawn play itself is shipped — [lawn match](lawn-match).

sections.title: Not finished yet
paras: The fantasy is one window: fight on the lawn, tap open, manage the RPG, Esc back.
Until it ships, use the launcher and browser path you already have.

sections.title: Design shape
sections.intro: What the WIP is aiming at:

cards.name: Open
cards.body: In-game button and F10 open the control room.

cards.name: Pause
cards.body: The board waits while you are in the RPG shell.

cards.name: Close
cards.body: Esc returns you; the match continues from the pause.

diagram: lawn-game window  ->  (button / F10)  ->  control room (paused board)

groups.title: Current path
steps: Start the local server / launcher flow you already use.
Open the control room in the browser.
Keep the lawn game and browser side by side until in-game open lands.
groups.note: Full teach page for that shell: [local control room](local-control-room).

doTitle: What you do while it is WIP
doSteps: Use launcher + browser for the control room today.
When in-game open appears, try the button or F10 once and confirm Esc pauses/closes as labeled.
Do not assume missing F10 means your keymap is wrong — the feature is still WIP.
doNote: Session shell today: [local control room](local-control-room). Board loop: [lawn match](lawn-match).

mixUps.a: In-game open is WIP. Use the browser control room for now.

mixUps.q: Do I need a second PC?
mixUps.a: No. Local launcher + browser on the same machine is the shipped path.

mixUps.q: Will opening the RPG quit my match?
mixUps.a: Design pauses the board while you are away — it should not trash the run.

mixUps.q: Is this a different control room?
mixUps.a: No. Same local control room — a shorter door into it.

mixUps.q: Can I play without the lawn game window?
mixUps.a: Yes for unlocked web features. This page is only about opening from inside the lawn window.
